description: This file defines a class `SawOscillatorDPW` which extends `SawOscillator`. It implements a band-limited sawtooth oscillator with methods to set frequency and render the waveform. It applies a specific digital waveform processing technique with internal state variables for delay and scaling based on frequency.

classes.name: SawOscillatorDPW
classes.description: A band-limited sawtooth oscillator employing waveform smoothing to reduce aliasing. Extends the `SawOscillator` class and overrides methods to implement frequency scaling and waveform rendering.

methods.name: setFrequency
methods.description: Sets the oscillator's frequency and calculates a frequency-dependent scaler to shape the waveform appropriately.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Computes the next sample of the oscillator's waveform using phase increment, internal delay states, and scaling.
